**MagicMap 2.2.1.** For WoW Forever, build 1.60.1.70790.

- **The time leads with day or night.** In the frame title, each time (local or server) starts with the minimap's own sun or moon in its gold ring, instead of AM or PM. The separate *Day or night* piece is gone.
- **New defaults,** tuned in play-testing:
  - **Title:** the zone and local time at rest; on hover, the zone, subzone, tracked target and distance.
  - **Quest pill:** backing at 60%.
  - **Track arrow:** 105% size, fully opaque, 96 px out.
  - **Tracked glow:** 200% size, fully opaque.
  - **Path line:** 1.4 px at 65%.
  
  Settings you've already changed are kept.

### Install
1. Download `MagicMap-v2.2.1.zip` below, or update from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/magic-map).
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old `MagicMap` folder.
3. `/reload` (no new files since 2.2.0). Your settings are kept.

Known: a followed quest's dots can look stretched over its disc ([#22](https://github.com/benmills/MagicMap/issues/22)).

Everything in 2.2: [the 2.2.0 notes](https://github.com/benmills/MagicMap/releases/tag/v2.2.0).
